name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys's motorsport journey began with a fascination for the physics of flight, leading him to aerodynamic principles and their application in racing. He spent his formative years tinkering with model aircraft and obsessively studying fluid dynamics before pursuing a degree in Aeronautical Engineering. After graduating, he joined a Formula 3 team, quickly demonstrating his aptitude for optimizing downforce and reducing drag. His innovative solutions attracted attention, and he soon found himself consulting for various GT teams before landing at Garage 59.

At Garage 59, Rhys is known for his meticulous approach and his ability to see the bigger picture. He emphasizes a holistic understanding of how aerodynamic changes impact the entire car's performance, not just individual components. He fosters a collaborative environment within his team, encouraging open communication and the free exchange of ideas. His visionary leadership and commitment to pushing the boundaries of aerodynamic design make him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a lean build and an intense, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a wind tunnel model of the current car on his desk.
